title: Bedrock: an attachment (`DocumentUrl`/`ImageUrl`) merged into the same user message as a `tool_result` → Converse `ValidationException`
author: ShurikAg

comments.author: pydanty[bot]
comments.body:
<!-- pydanty:status-comment:v1 -->

## pydanty status: bug

**Classification:** bug

**Why this matters:** Multi-turn Bedrock apps where a tool call ends a turn and the next user turn includes a file attachment (DocumentUrl/ImageUrl/BinaryContent) will fail with a Converse ValidationException. This is a natural and common interaction pattern — the model calls a tool, gets results, then the user sends a new message with a document. The bug makes Bedrock unusable for this flow, while the same pattern works on OpenAI. Affects any Pydantic AI user on Bedrock with tools + attachments in multi-turn conversations.

**Evidence summary:** No delegate evidence was gathered this run. All six delegate calls failed: reproducer (path error then budget exhaustion), code_librarian (UnexpectedModelBehavior x3 then budget exhaustion), repositorian (UnexpectedModelBehavior), explorer (UnexpectedModelBehavior x2). The issue report itself names specific code paths (_clean_message_history in _agent_graph.py merging consecutive ModelRequests, BedrockConverseModel._map_messages merging consecutive user messages), provides a runnable reproduction script, and includes the exact AWS error. The reported version is pydantic-ai-slim 1.60.0 claimed unchanged on main/2.0. However, per pydanty policy, a bug cannot be marked PR-ready without a reproducer result from this or a chained run, and no reproducer evidence was obtained.

**Next action:** needs_maintainer_discussion -- Reproduction was not completed — all delegates (reproducer, code_librarian, repositorian, explorer) failed due to infrastructure issues (model behavior errors, path errors, budget exhaustion). Cannot classify as PR-ready without reproducer confirmation per policy. The issue report is high-quality and credible but the evidence gap must be stated honestly.

Bedrock adapter merges a trailing tool_result ModelRequest with a following attachment-bearing ModelRequest into one Converse user message containing [toolResult, text, document], which Bedrock Claude models reject with ValidationException. The issue is well-reported with a concrete reproduction script and named code paths. However, all delegate calls failed this run due to infrastructure issues — reproduction was not completed and no code_librarian or repositorian evidence was gathered. Classifying as a bug, but routing to needs_maintainer_discussion because the evidence gap from delegate failures prevents PR-ready classification. When delegates are available, the next step is to reproduce by running the reporter's script against current checked-in code, then locate the merge logic in BedrockConverseModel._map_messages and _clean_message_history for a localized fix that prevents co-locating attachment blocks with toolResult blocks.
